umf.visual.title: V5 · When a response is lost
umf.visual.question: When a response is lost

nodes.label: Client → consumer
nodes.detail:
Send original token, revision, typed
inputs and expected versions. Trusted
context supplies actor identity.

nodes.label: Consumer → native store
nodes.detail:
Commit business changes, verification
and terminal outcome atomically. Then
the acknowledgement is lost.

nodes.label:
Response lost · Client
knowledge · indeterminate
nodes.detail:
Unknown whether commit occurred.
Timeout does not prove rollback. Keep
the original request; do not mint a
fresh token.

nodes.label: Client → protected lookup
nodes.detail:
Current discovery and original-result
authorization gate lookup. Return the
retained original outcome; lookup
never executes.

nodes.label: Missing or expired
nodes.detail:
Missing after uncertainty is not
permission to reexecute. No-key
requests lack keyed recovery
guarantees.

omissions: This is a concept-map presentation of the original tutorial panels. Original storyboard-specific positions, swimlanes, sequence lifelines, state glyphs and timeline geometry are not reproduced. All authored panel text remains visible and in the source companion.

panels.title: Client → consumer
panels.text: Send original token, revision, typed inputs and expected versions. Trusted context supplies actor identity.

panels.title: Consumer → native store
panels.text: Commit business changes, verification and terminal outcome atomically. Then the acknowledgement is lost.

panels.title: Client knowledge · indeterminate
panels.text: Unknown whether commit occurred. Timeout does not prove rollback. Keep the original request; do not mint a fresh token.

panels.title: Client → protected lookup
panels.text: Current discovery and original-result authorization gate lookup. Return the retained original outcome; lookup never executes.

panels.title: Missing or expired
panels.text: Missing after uncertainty is not permission to reexecute. No-key requests lack keyed recovery guarantees.
